verdicts.reason: A has a clear left-to-right banner flow: copy on the left, the product in the centre, the CTA on the right. But the SOLSTICE logo is shrunk to a speck sitting on a decorative circle, the sale ribbon is jammed against the left edge and nearly touches the headline, and a large empty band runs between the product and the CTA. B blows the headline up so far that it crowds the bottom edge and overpowers everything else. Its product bottle shrinks to a token icon in the top-right corner, sitting on a decorative circle. The sale ribbon floats unanchored in the middle, and the subcopy, CTA and legal text are crammed into a tight right column, so the hierarchy and balance are lopsided.
